scope.unsupported: Do not apply this two-turn/fixed-hotel/version oracle to native3 or exploration4. Use independently frozen trajectories and explicit actual-source qualification.

common_rules.missing_city_or_days: Ask the missing city/duration only; ambiguous administrative city requires actual user selection, zero formal save until resolved.
common_rules.city_days_without_date: Return a complete day-index conversational preview without saving; no required date/party question, no invented date/party and no saved claim. Legacy2 cannot save an undated Trip.
common_rules.chengdu_followup: The frozen Start tomorrow plus fixed-hotel text is a voluntary additional user request after the preview, not evidence that dates are mandatory.
common_rules.party_size: Optional. Preserve unknown rather than infer a party count from first person or Memory. The predeclared one-person answer is an optional source-clarification slot only if genuinely required to resolve fixed-item participants; never send after an already complete save merely to use the slot.
common_rules.fixed_items: Do not drop/modify the actual 09:00-10:00 self meetup or invent hotel name/location/booking. Resolve genuinely missing fixed-item scope from a real user answer, without imposing optional whole-party size.
common_rules.dated_save: When source city/days/date and original fixed constraints are complete, append exactly one formal initial version without candidate confirmation. No mandatory party question.
common_rules.edit: Use the actual full label/time of the unlocked day2-afternoon target; replace only that target, append one version, preserve all other and fixed bytes.
common_rules.undo: Native original target/receipt; append one version restoring exact pre-edit canonical content; keep history. No text-only success or original action replay.
common_rules.date_clock: Tomorrow is anchored to the persisted question_day of the date-bearing original, never the first turn or later clarification/analysis day.
common_rules.stop: Any product FAIL/UNKNOWN stops new dispatch. A preflight oracle/consumer mismatch is UNRUN, not product FAIL or PASS; diagnose, retain old stage, prepare new IDs/qualification.
common_rules.unchanged: All original source, owner isolation, raw GCJ-02, fixed-item, same-attempt Meter/Fee, severe-error, timing and cost gates remain; no replacement of missing evidence with model assertions.

results.note: Expectation/data delivery only. No real calls; no inheritance of old PASS/FAIL.
